correctness.rationale: Cycle grounded Green kernel H_ij=min(i,j)(n-max(i,j))/n gives r=d(n-d)/n, column sums and q=(H^2)_bb. Schur-complement/Schur rank-one updates yield CC, CL and LL objective formulas. Each decreases with r, LL exceeds CL by a rational expression with positive coefficients, and CL-CC changes sign at 3/[1+2(n-3)R_n]. Independently formed exact rational grounded Laplacians and exhaustively compared every leader pair for n=3..5 and t=1/3,1,3, including boundary cases. The proof, not samples, handles all n and t.
